# Campaigns and records

Long-running searches as a stepped campaign, plus read-only access to everything already measured: results by lineage, leaderboards, and the public benchmark corpus.

## campaign_frontier

The campaign's Pareto frontier: per-objective values with CI bounds, fidelity (screen vs escalation rung), and result row ids for full lineage. `include_contenders` adds the escalation set — everything the screening data cannot rule out (docs/decisions.md D218).

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `db_path` | `str` |  |
| `campaign_id` | `str` |  |

??? note "1 optional parameter"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `include_contenders` | `bool` | `False` |  |

## campaign_resume

Resume a paused or budget-exhausted campaign, optionally topping up the budget (e.g. {"evaluations": 16}) as an append-only ledger event. Refuses terminal campaigns (stopped/done) — any changed objective is a new campaign, never a mutation.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `db_path` | `str` |  |
| `campaign_id` | `str` |  |

??? note "2 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `top_up` | `dict[str, float] \| None` | `None` |  |
    | `max_trials` | `int \| None` | `None` |  |

## campaign_start

Create or resume a durable, multi-objective search campaign from an Objective IR document (docs/decisions.md D216-D220).

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `objective` | `dict[str, Any]` | Objective IR document — objectives (metric + direction, optionally weighted), mode ("pareto" \| "weighted"), workload/base_arch (inline documents or store refs), backends (screening + optional escalation rungs), search space |
| `db_path` | `str` | SQLite file for all campaign state and results. |

??? note "1 optional parameter"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `run_trials` | `int` | `0` | 0 creates and checkpoints only; N > 0 also runs up to N trials now. |

## campaign_status

Campaign status without running anything: phase, per-status trial counts, the derived budget ledger (granted/spent/remaining — `usd` stays null when no backend ever reported a cost), frontier size, non-deterministic trial count, and the event tail.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `db_path` | `str` |  |
| `campaign_id` | `str` |  |

## campaign_step

Run up to `max_trials` more trials of an existing campaign — the agent-paced mode.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `db_path` | `str` |  |
| `campaign_id` | `str` |  |

??? note "4 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `max_trials` | `int` | `1` |  |
    | `screening_parallelism` | `int` | `1` |  |
    | `knowledge_facts` | `list[dict[str, Any]] \| None` | `None` |  |
    | `knowledge_text` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |

## campaign_stop

Terminally stop a campaign, recording the reason. A double stop is refused with the original reason, so the caller learns why it already stopped.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `db_path` | `str` |  |
| `campaign_id` | `str` |  |

??? note "1 optional parameter"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `reason` | `str` | `''` |  |

## find_results

Query previously stored results by any combination of lineage fields — omitting all three returns every stored result. Use this to check whether a candidate has already been evaluated before spending budget on it again.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `db_path` | `str` | Path to a `flux_store.ResultStore` SQLite file. |

??? note "3 optional parameters"

    | parameter | type | default | what it is |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | `workload_hash` | `str \| None` | `None` | Restrict to results for this workload content hash, or omit. |
    | `arch_hash` | `str \| None` | `None` | Restrict to results for this architecture content hash, or omit. |
    | `evaluator` | `str \| None` | `None` | Restrict to results from this evaluator |

## get_result

Fetch one previously stored evaluator `Result` by row id, with its full lineage (workload/architecture/mapping content hashes, evaluator name) — `None` if no such id exists in the store.

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `db_path` | `str` | Path to a `flux_store.ResultStore` SQLite file. |
| `result_id` | `int` | Row id returned when the result was originally stored. |

## leaderboard

Ranks every stored result for a **public** corpus entry's workload — across every architecture anyone has ever evaluated it against, not just that entry's own named `arch_path` — by its declared objective, best first (docs/decisions.md D58).

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `corpus_root` | `str` | path to the `corpus/` directory (its parent is treated as the repo root for resolving the entry's `workload_path`, same convention every corpus-consuming test in this repo already assumes). |
| `entry_id` | `str` | a public corpus entry's `id` (see `list_public_corpus`). |
| `db_path` | `str` | path to the `ResultStore` SQLite file to rank results from. |

## list_public_corpus

List every **public** benchmark corpus entry under `corpus_root` — a (workload, architecture) pair plus a description of why it's a useful benchmark point. Never includes the holdout partition: there is no argument on this tool that can ask for it, by design — the holdout partition exists specifically so no agent or search strategy can see it (docs/roadmap.md's validation methodology).

| parameter | type | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `corpus_root` | `str` | Path to a corpus directory containing `public/` and `holdout/` subdirectories of entry manifests (see `corpus/README.md`). |
